title: NSC study on disclosure of recovered craft under George W. Bush
place_text: National Security Council; Office of Net Assessment

tellings.quote: Now, you know, there was a report that um that the National Security Council under uh George W. Bush did commission a study of whether the time was had come for quote disclosure

plain: Under George W. Bush, the National Security Council is said to have commissioned a study, with the Pentagon's Office of Net Assessment, of whether the time had come for "disclosure", meaning telling the public about recovered craft. A Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell mentions this report, which he ties to a man named Sean Kirkpatrick. If true, it would mean the White House seriously weighed going public.
